theater: 伊利里亞與馬其頓邊境

battle.name: 高盧入侵巴爾幹
battle.theater: 伊利里亞與馬其頓邊境
battle.brief: 前281年，高盧首領布倫努斯率眾越過多瑙河，驅逐陶蘭提伊人，與伊利里亞王莫努尼烏斯兩度交鋒，又在馬其頓邊境被卡山德的重步兵方陣擊潰，翌年更深入希臘洗劫德爾斐。卡面的科林斯青銅盔正是這支部隊頭上的裝備：正面只留窄縫，戴盔者看不見側背，只能靠隊形活。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 高盧入侵巴爾幹是一場發生在亞得里亞海東岸的戰役，戰爭索引定其起點為前281年；古代作者本身對年份就有分歧，波里比俄斯的敘事屬於前279年那一波，李維則把前280至前279年分列在第四十、四十一卷。交戰四方如下。第一方是高盧人，即塞爾特人聯軍：核心是從多瑙河中游渡來的塞爾特部族，首領布倫努斯。他們沒有固定國界，也沒有常備兵員，部隊由各部族的「王」率領，編制鬆散而人數眾多。約前280年，埃托利亞聯盟與亞該亞聯盟爭鬥，洛克里人與亞該亞一方先後邀請高盧人出兵相助，高盧人藉這張邀請渡海進入伊利里亞，開戰時攜帶家屬、牛群與車隊，是典型的「全民皆兵」式遷徙軍。第二方是伊利里亞聯盟，以阿爾迪亞伊人王莫努尼烏斯為核心，聯合奧圖阿里亞泰人、陶蘭提伊人與達爾達尼人等山地部族，以輕步兵、投石手與熟悉峽谷的步兵見長。第三方是馬其頓王國，安提柯王朝的國王卡山德率步兵方陣、騎兵與雇傭的伊利里亞、色雷斯輕步兵迎擊，是本役決定勝負的一方；此時安提柯王朝正把勢力伸入伊利里亞。第四方是希臘方，於戰役第二階段登場：亞該亞聯盟、埃托利亞聯盟、洛克里人、佛基亞人與比奧西亞人等城邦聯盟。亞該亞人起初允許高盧軍借道深入希臘本土，理由是寧可讓高盧人自己去搶洛里斯的財物，也不要親自出兵對付埃托利亞人。這是波里比俄斯留下的著名記錄，也是整場戰事最關鍵的一次政治判斷。
countriesEn: The Gallic incursion into the Balkans was a war fought on the eastern shore of the Adriatic, dated to 281 BC in this index; the ancient authors themselves differ, since Polybius narrates the wave of 279 BC while Livy spreads the events of 280 and 279 BC across his fortieth and forty-first books. Four parties appear in the sources. The first is the Gauls, a Celtic tribal confederation that had come down the middle Danube under the war-leader Brennus, with no fixed frontier and no standing army, its units drawn up by the kings of the several tribes and organised loosely but in great numbers. Around 280 BC, with the Aetolian League and the Achaean League quarrelling, the Locrians and the Achaean side in turn invited Gallic troops to intervene, and the Gauls used that invitation to cross the Adriatic into Illyria. They came as a migrating host, with families, cattle and wagons moving with the column, the whole people under arms. The second is the Illyrian alliance, built around Monunius king of the Ardiaei and joined by the Autariatae, the Taulantii and the Dardani, highland peoples strong in light infantry, slings and fighting among gorges. The third is the kingdom of Macedon under the Antigonids: King Cassander led up the phalanx, the cavalry and hired Illyrian and Thracian light infantry, and was the side that decided the campaign, at a time when his dynasty was pushing its power into Illyria. The fourth is the Greek side, which enters in the second phase: the Achaean and Aetolian leagues, the Locrians, the Phocians and the Boeotians. The Achaeans first allowed the Gallic host to pass into the Greek mainland, on the reasoning recorded by Polybius that it was better to let the Gauls strip Locri of its wealth than to march against the Aetolians themselves. That is the famous judgement, and the hinge of the whole affair.
people: 布倫努斯是本役唯一留下姓名的統帥。他是高盧聯軍的首領，率軍渡海進入巴爾幹，先與伊利里亞人交戰，再與馬其頓方陣相撞，隨後把戰火引向希臘本土。他不是前390年攻陷羅馬的塞農人首領布倫努斯，那是另一位同名的塞爾特將領，但後世常把兩人混為一談。波里比俄斯寫他在塞林古以南的提尼奧斯河一帶中了洛克里人與梅薩比人的伏擊而被殺，屍首被分割帶回故里，軍隊隨之解散，掠得的財貨則在往後流入羅馬的市場。莫努尼烏斯是阿爾迪亞伊人的王，他率伊利里亞聯軍與高盧人先勝後敗：第一次接觸時高盧人受挫，第二次決戰中兵敗身亡，聯盟隨之瓦解，正是這場勝利讓高盧人得以直入馬其頓。卡山德是安提柯王朝的國王、安提帕特爾之子，此時剛從父喪與兄弟爭端中鞏固王位，北方邊境驟然暴露在高盧壓力之下時被迫抽調兵團迎戰。這一戰是他執政早期最清晰的戰功，方陣在正面擋住高盧騎兵的衝擊，再以騎兵與輕步兵打崩對方側翼。埃托利亞與亞該亞兩方的首領姓名在存世片段中多不可考，唯一被記下名字的是洛克里人，他們一邊請高盧人出兵，一邊在後來付錢請高盧軍退出，又設伏殺死布倫努斯。在記錄者方面，波里比俄斯是距離事件最近的史家，《歷史》第四卷專記巴爾幹戰事；李維在第四十、四十一卷續寫希臘本土部分；狄奧多羅斯、查士丁尼與科奈利烏斯・涅波提供了補充的年表與數字，但都離事件更遠。
peopleEn: Brennus is the only commander of this war whose name survives. He led the Gallic confederation across the sea into the Balkans, fought the Illyrians, collided with the Macedonian phalanx, and then carried the war into Greece proper. He is not the Senonian leader of the same name who sacked Rome in 390 BC, though later writers have confused the two. Polybius records that Brennus was caught in an ambush by the Locrians and the Messapians near the river Thinnius south of Thermopylae and killed; his body was cut up and carried home, the host dissolved where it stood, and the booty eventually found its way to the markets of Rome. Monunius, king of the Ardiaei, led the Illyrian confederation and won and lost against the Gauls in turn: the Gauls were checked in the first contact, and in the second and decisive battle he was killed and the alliance broke apart with him, and it was that victory which opened the road to Macedon for the Gauls. Cassander, king of Macedon and son of Antipater, had only just consolidated his rule after his father's death and the quarrel with his brothers, and found the northern frontier suddenly exposed to Gallic pressure. The battle is the clearest victory of his early reign: the phalanx absorbed the Gallic cavalry charge in front, and the cavalry and light infantry finished the Gauls on the flanks. The names of the Aetolian and Achaean leaders do not survive in the fragments; the only people remembered by name are the Locrians, who invited the Gauls in, then paid for their withdrawal, and finally ambushed and killed Brennus. Among the recorders, Polybius stands closest to the events and devotes the fourth book of his Histories to the fighting in the Balkans; Livy continues the Greek phase in books forty and forty-one; Diodorus Siculus, Justin and Cornelius Nepos supply a supplementary framework of dates and figures, but all of them stand further from the event.
kits: 卡面所選的科林斯青銅盔是一件真正希臘造型的頭盔：整片青銅鍛成形，鼻樑下垂，眼睛只留兩道狹縫，兩側有護頰，後方有頸甲，最後還留一截讓辮髮束起的開口。它在科林斯本地約於前7世紀成形，前6至前5世紀是希臘重裝步兵的標準配備，前4世紀之後在希臘本土逐漸被敞口的阿提卡式與卡爾基迪亞式頭盔取代；但在馬其頓，安提柯王朝的方陣於3世紀重新拾起科林斯式頭盔，亞歷山大後繼者的方陣兵直到前2世紀的松海戰役仍戴著它。所以在本役裡，這頂盔並非希臘城邦民兵的老古董，而正是卡山德方陣頭上的制式裝備。高盧人自己的頭盔是另一種形制：青銅盔體，前端有一枚向前的突起，後方有護頸，臉部完全敞開，沒有鼻樑。波里比俄斯描述他們的裝備還包括深紫色的胸甲與護腿、長盾（部分呈月牙形）、長柄刺槍，以及騎兵使用的小圓盾。兩相比較之下，卡面那句話正是在本役被印證：戴上科林斯盔，視野只剩正前方一道窄縫，士兵無法靠視覺察覺側後方的變化，只能靠身旁人的動作與號令維持秩序；高盧人戴的頭盔不妨礙視野，卻同樣沒有甲冑體系與陣形紀律來彌補。同場的其他裝備：馬其頓方陣以長達六米的薩里沙長槊（雙手持握）、小型圓盾佩爾特、亞麻布胸甲（外加金屬片加固）、短劍與標槍組成；步兵方陣之外配有伊利里亞與色雷斯的輕步兵（投石手、投槍手）、馬其頓騎兵與色雷斯式騎兵。馬其頓軍沒有攻城器械，本役也沒有圍城戰的記載；高盧人同樣不帶攻城塔，他們的戰爭是純粹的野戰與劫掠，糧食靠隨軍牛群、車隊與就地向村莊徵收。役後高盧人帶走的希臘藝術品與廟宇寶物，經日後轉手，成為羅馬市場上所謂塞爾特戰利品的來源。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card is a genuinely Greek form: a single piece of hammered bronze with a continuous nose guard, two narrow eye slits, cheek pieces, a neck guard at the back, and an opening at the rear for the wearer's tied hair. It was developed at Corinth around the seventh century BC, was standard equipment for Greek hoplites in the sixth and fifth centuries, and was displaced in Greece proper during the fourth century by the open-faced Attic and Chalcidian types; but in Macedon the Antigonid phalanx took the Corinthian form up again in the third century, and the phalangites of Alexander's successors were still wearing it at Pydna in the second century. In this war the helmet is therefore not a museum piece belonging to a citizen levy: it is precisely the standard kit on the head of Cassander's phalanx. The Gauls wore a different form, a bronze shell with a forward-pointing apex, a neck guard behind and the face entirely open, with no nasal at all. Polybius also describes their breastplate and leggings in a dark purple colour, their long shields, some oblong and some curved like a half-moon, their long thrusting spears, and the small round shield carried by their cavalry. The comparison is the point of the card, for the price paid for seeing with a Corinthian helmet is paid off in this campaign. Worn, it gives the wearer a narrow slot of vision straight ahead and lets him detect nothing moving to flank or rear; he can keep his place only by the movement of the man beside him and by the call of the herald. The Gallic helmet leaves the face open, but the Gauls had no armour system and no formation discipline to make up for it. The rest of the order of battle: the Macedonian phalanx with its sarissas of about six metres worked two-handed, the smaller round pelte, the linen cuirass stiffened with metal plates, the short sword and the javelin; alongside it Illyrian and Thracian light infantry with slings and javelins, Macedonian horse and Thracian-style cavalry. The Macedonians brought no siege engines and the campaign contains no siege; the Gauls brought none either, for theirs was a war of movement and plunder, fed by the cattle and wagons that moved with the host and by levies taken from the villages they passed. The Greek art and temple treasure the Gauls carried away passed from hand to hand afterwards and became the source of what the Roman market knew as Celtic spoils.
tactics: 高盧軍的戰術是典型的塞爾特部族風格：步兵以密集隊形推進，長柄刺槍在近身處纏鬥，騎兵則成大隊衝鋒，企圖用衝擊力把對手陣線撞散。波里比俄斯記載的馬其頓戰役中，高盧人把騎兵集中在正面，一度突入方陣的側翼，但步兵方陣以薩里沙槍林穩住陣腳，並未被衝開；真正的破綻出現在高盧軍的側翼與背後，那裡沒有步兵掩護。馬其頓人的應法是把伊利里亞與色雷斯的輕步兵、騎兵繞到側翼，正面以方陣牽制，等高盧軍縱隊拉開、指揮序列斷裂時，一齊發動總攻。伊利里亞一方則完全依靠地形：山地部族以小隊控制峽谷與坡地，居高臨下用投石與標槍消耗高盧人的密集隊形；狹窄通道裡，高盧人最倚賴的騎兵衝鋒難以展開，人數優勢反而變成累贅。第一次接觸時高盧人因此受挫，直到第二次決戰在開闊地帶進行，伊利里亞聯軍才遭擊潰。進入希臘本土後形勢重演：前279年高盧軍在塞林古強攻聯軍防線，那裡是德摩比利與希臘大陸之間的狹窄山口，密集隊形在狹窄地形上無法施展，攻勢被擋住；扭轉戰局的是側翼，來自洛克里的騎兵衝擊高盧軍暴露的側翼，聯軍才得以把進攻逐退。整體看，本役勝負的關鍵不在任何一方的人數，而在能否讓隊形保持完整：馬其頓方陣做得到，塞爾特式密集卻鬆散的軍隊做不到。補給線上，馬其頓軍依托城鎮與既有道路作戰，遠離補給點的分遣隊容易被切斷；高盧軍則不設補給線，隨軍牛群與車隊即時取食，走到哪裡吃到哪裡，這使他們在希臘境內作戰可以很兇，卻意味著一旦被擋在城牆之外、找不到可掠的村莊，就無法恢復士氣。最終的和平不是靠戰場上的殲滅，而是靠洛克里人付出一筆巨款，讓高盧軍主動退出希臘。
tacticsEn: The Gallic method was the standard Celtic one: infantry pressing forward in dense order, long spears at close quarters, cavalry massed for the charge in the hope of shattering the opposing line. In the Macedonian battle as Polybius describes it, the Gauls concentrated their horse on the front and at moments broke into the flank of the phalanx, but the sarissa wall held its footing and was not broken; the real weakness lay on the Gallic flanks and rear, where there was no infantry to screen them. The Macedonians answered by sending Illyrian and Thracian light infantry and horse round the side, holding the front with the phalanx, and striking in one general attack once the Gallic column had stretched out and the chain of command had come apart. The Illyrians worked entirely through the terrain: small parties held gorges and slopes and spent the Gauls' dense formations with slingstones and javelins from above, while in the narrow defiles the Gallic cavalry, their chief strength, could not deploy, and numbers became a burden instead of an advantage. The Gauls were checked in that first contact and were only broken in the second, fought in open ground. The pattern repeated in Greece proper: in 279 BC the Gallic host assaulted the allied line at Thermopylae, the narrow pass by Demylus between the Malian Gulf and the Greek mainland, where density could not be used because the ground was too narrow, and the attack was halted; the turning point came on the flank, where the Locrian horse struck the exposed side of the Gallic host and the allies pushed the attack back. In the whole affair the deciding factor was not numbers but whether a formation could be kept intact. The Macedonian phalanx could; the Celtic mass, dense but slack, could not. On the line of supply the Macedonians fought from their towns and existing roads, and detached parties were cut off when they strayed too far from the magazines; the Gauls had no supply line at all, living off the cattle and wagons that moved with them, which let them be ferocious inside Greece but left them without heart once a city was shut against them and the villages beyond stripped. The peace at the end was not won on the field but bought: the Locrians paid a large sum for the Gallic host to leave Greece.
data: 本役留下的數字幾乎全部出自古代作家的估算，必須打折來看。兵員方面，波里比俄斯在《歷史》第四卷估計渡海進入希臘的高盧軍約八萬步兵、二萬騎兵（含各部族援軍），並解釋說整個塞爾特民族人口稠密，所以這樣的總數可信；查士丁尼給出的數字更高，約十二萬步兵、一萬五千騎兵；以現代學界較保守的推估，多半落在數萬人的量級，大軍規模無疑是數萬人級別，但古代數字幾乎肯定含有整數湊數的成分。戰果方面有兩組較具體的記錄：一是馬其頓之戰，波里比俄斯記高盧方面陣亡約二萬、被俘約三萬，馬其頓方面陣亡約二百、負傷約三百；二是前279年塞林古之戰，希臘聯軍損失約一千名步兵與兩百名騎兵。前一組出自勝方敘述，方向可信而絕對值偏高。時間與距離上，從多瑙河中游到亞得里亞海東岸的伊利里亞，軍行約數百公里；從巴爾幹到塞林古的海峽關口，總行程在一千二百至一千五百公里量級。戰役橫跨兩個完整的作戰年度：前281至前280年在巴爾幹作戰，前279年進入希臘本土，同年便撤退北返；具體月份在古代記載中並沒有留下，本卡以春季出兵的作戰季節計。戰役次數方面，波里比俄斯記錄了高盧人與伊利里亞人的兩次交鋒、與馬其頓人的一次主力戰，以及塞林古的一戰。損失的另一面是高盧聯盟自身的崩解：布倫努斯死後軍隊瓦解，大量高盧人滯留巴爾幹與希臘境內，後來成為希臘與馬其頓雇傭軍的來源，返鄉者寥寥。亦有記載提到高盧人帶走大量希臘廟宇財寶與青銅器、青銅頭盔，成為後來羅馬市場上塞爾特戰利品的來源。
dataEn: Almost every number attached to this war is an ancient estimate and has to be discounted. On the strength of the force, Polybius, in the fourth book of his Histories, reckons the Gauls who crossed the sea into Greece at about eighty thousand foot and twenty thousand horse, allies from the other tribes included, and explains that such a total is credible because the whole Celtic nation is populous. Justin gives higher figures, roughly one hundred and twenty thousand foot and fifteen thousand horse. Modern estimates, more conservative, generally put the host in the tens of thousands: that it was a very large army is certain, but the ancient totals plainly contain a good deal of round-number inflation. Two sets of figures for the fighting are more specific. The first is the Macedonian battle, where Polybius records about twenty thousand Gauls killed and thirty thousand captured, against about two hundred Macedonians dead and three hundred wounded. The second is Thermopylae in 279 BC, where the Greek allies lost about a thousand foot and two hundred horse. The first pair comes from the winning side and is reliable in direction if not in absolute value. On time and distance, the march from the middle Danube to the Illyrian shore of the Adriatic ran to several hundred kilometres, and the whole road to the pass at Thermopylae lay in the order of twelve to fifteen hundred kilometres. The campaign covered two full campaigning years, the fighting in the Balkans in 281 and 280 BC and the entry into Greece in 279, with the withdrawal north in the same year; the exact months do not survive in the ancient accounts, and this card counts the spring campaigning season. On the number of engagements, Polybius records two collisions with the Illyrians, one pitched battle against the Macedonians, and the fight at Thermopylae. The other side of the ledger is the breakdown of the Gallic host: with Brennus dead the army dissolved, large numbers stayed behind in the Balkans and in Greece to be absorbed as Hellenic and Macedonian mercenaries, and few returned home. The records also have the Gauls carrying off temple treasure and a great quantity of bronze vessels and bronze helmets, the source of what the Roman market later knew as Celtic spoils.
cause: 直接導火線是一場聯盟之間的戰爭。埃托利亞聯盟在希臘中部擴張，與亞該亞聯盟摩擦不斷；前3世紀末，洛克里人與亞該亞人先後邀請高盧人出兵相助，希望借助塞爾特人的刀兵解決對手。高盧人接受了邀請，而波里比俄斯留下了一個尖刻的觀察：亞該亞人寧可讓高盧人自己去搶洛里斯的財物，也不願親自出兵對付埃托利亞人。深層原因則是巴爾幹半島的結構性變化。前4世紀起，塞爾特人渡過多瑙河進入中歐與巴爾幹，擠壓色雷斯與伊利里亞諸部的生存空間，被擠壓的山地部族聯合起來對抗，卻不是為了建立國家，而是為了守住地盤。與此同時，安提柯王朝的馬其頓正把勢力伸入伊利里亞：卡山德先後在阿爾迪亞伊人、奧圖阿里亞泰人身上用兵，奪地、索貢、推行屯田，部族之間原有的緩衝地帶被壓縮，高盧人的到來因此成了壓垮平衡的外來力量。還有一層是塞爾特人自身的傳統：跨海的劫掠與受雇作戰，是高盧部族早已習慣的生路，前4世紀的塞農人曾以此洗劫羅馬。當亞該亞人把邀請送到多瑙河畔，這支已經學會為羅馬城邦作傭兵的軍隊看到的是一條通往豐饒海岸的路徑，於是傾巢南下。對高盧首領而言，援軍的身份只是通行符，真正的目標是財貨與戰功。
causeEn: The immediate spark was a war between two leagues. The Aetolian League was expanding in central Greece and its friction with the Achaean League was constant; towards the end of the third century BC the Locrians and the Achaeans in turn invited Gallic troops to intervene, hoping to settle the matter with Celtic swords. The Gauls accepted, and Polybius left behind a biting comment on the Achaeans: they would rather let the Gauls strip Locri of its wealth than march against the Aetolians themselves. The deeper cause lies in the structure of the Balkans. From the fourth century BC the Celts crossed the Danube into central Europe and the Balkans, squeezing the Thracians and the Illyrians out of their lands; the displaced highland peoples banded together to resist, not to build a state but to hold their ground. At the same time Antigonid Macedon was pushing its power into Illyria: Cassander had campaigned against the Ardiaei and the Autariatae, taking land, collecting tribute and settling soldier-colonists, and the buffer that had existed between the tribes was compressed. The arrival of the Gauls therefore fell on a balance already broken from the inside. There was also a Gallic habit to weigh: overseas plunder and service for hire were old trades among these peoples, and the Senones had already sacked Rome in the fourth century. When the Achaeans sent their invitation down to the Danube, a people already schooled as mercenaries in the service of the Roman Republic saw a road to a rich coast and came south in force. To the Gallic war-leader the invitation was only a pass; the true object was booty and glory.
impact: 短期看，希臘世界第一次遭遇一支可以正面擊敗希臘城邦聯軍的歐洲大陸軍隊。塞林古被突破，雅典與比奧西亞的城門一度告急，德爾斐神廟在劫掠中被燒，廟宇積存數百年的寶物被洗劫一空，這場浩劫在希臘的集體記憶中留下的痕跡，比任何一場城邦之間的戰爭都深。政治上的後果則是長期而殘酷的。伊利里亞聯盟在莫努尼烏斯陣亡後解體，阿爾迪亞伊人、奧圖阿里亞泰人這些先前的強勢部族退入山區，古典作家筆下那個能與馬其頓抗衡的伊利里亞王國從此不再存在；巴爾幹的權力真空被後來崛起的達爾達尼人等部族瓜分，羅馬在2世紀中葉下伊利里亞時，面對的已是一個碎裂的高原世界，而不是一個統一的王國。更長遠的一層是塞爾特人這個認同被固定下來。這場戰爭之後，希臘與拉丁作家開始用加利太亞人稱呼塞爾特人；前278年後大批高盧人東進安納托利亞，在比西尼亞與色雷斯定居，亞細亞的加拉太人從此存在，並在此後兩百年間成為小亞細亞與地中海世界政治與雇傭兵市場上一支不可忽視的力量。羅馬的反應同樣值得記錄：據說元老院聽到高盧人已經越過亞得里亞海的消息後，立刻派出使節前往亞該亞與埃托利亞兩方遊說，並向伊庇魯方向派出數千人的援軍。羅馬人記憶裡還有前390年塞農人攻陷羅馬的舊帳，因此對塞爾特人的刀格外敏感；前279年這一場入侵因此成為羅馬政策的轉折點之一，羅馬日後介入巴爾幹，起初正是以保護盟友、對付高盧餘部的名義。
impactEn: In the short term the Greek world met for the first time a continental army able to defeat a coalition of its own city-states outright. Thermopylae was forced, the gates of Athens and Boeotia were threatened, and the temple of Delphi was burned and plundered, its treasure accumulated over centuries swept away; in the Greek collective memory the sack left a deeper mark than any ordinary war between city-states. The political consequences were long and cruel. After the death of Monunius the Illyrian alliance dissolved; the Ardiaei and the Autariatae, formerly the strong powers, withdrew into the hills, and the Illyrian kingdom that classical writers describe as a match for Macedon ceased to exist. The vacuum in the Balkans was divided among the Dardani and the other tribes that rose later, so that when Rome came down into Illyria in the middle of the second century BC it met a fragmented highland world rather than a unified kingdom. More durable still was the fixing of the name Celt. After this war Greek and Latin writers began to call the Celts Galatai; when large numbers of Gauls moved east into Anatolia and settled in Bithynia and Thrace from 278 BC, the Galatian of Asia Minor became a permanent presence and, for two centuries, an unavoidable force in the politics and the mercenary markets of the eastern Mediterranean. Rome's reaction deserves its own line: the senate, on the news that the Gauls were already across the Adriatic, is said to have sent embassies to press the Achaean and Aetolian leagues and to have sent several thousand men to Epirus. Romans still had the bill from 390 BC, when the Senones took the city itself, and were sensitive to the Celtic blade; the invasion of 279 BC thus became one of the turning points of Roman policy, and Rome's later intervention across the Balkans began under the colours of protecting allies against the Gallic remnants.
result: 巴爾幹階段的結果很清楚：高盧人在伊利里亞境內贏了兩陣，卻在馬其頓邊境輸掉唯一一場決定性的會戰。卡山德的方陣在正面頂住高盧騎兵的衝擊，靠側翼的輕步兵與騎兵完成反擊，高盧方面陣亡約二萬、被俘約三萬，兵源損失近半，聯盟的戰鬥力被打斷；這也是本役唯一一場可以判定勝負的會戰。希臘階段的結果則更像一次成功的劫掠而非征服。前279年高盧軍在塞林古受阻後仍攻入希臘，燒劫德爾斐與其他城邑，把廟宇財物洗劫一空；最後是洛克里人付出巨款請他們退出希臘半島，高盧軍才掉頭北返。北返途中，布倫努斯在塞林古以南的提尼奧斯河一帶中了洛克里人與梅薩比人的伏擊被殺，大軍隨即瓦解。對雙方的長期結果都一樣殘酷：高盧人帶回了財富，卻沒有帶回征服；希臘聯盟保住了本土，卻付出了一筆足以壓垮一城邦的贖金，並在隨後十幾年裡繼續受高盧餘部的劫掠所苦。巴爾幹的局勢則在混亂中定型：伊利里亞的聯盟崩解，馬其頓的邊境第一次直接暴露在高盧式的突擊之下，安提柯王朝此後對北方的經營從征服轉為防禦。
resultEn: The result of the Balkan phase is plain. The Gauls won two engagements in Illyria and lost the one decisive pitched battle on the Macedonian border. Cassander's phalanx absorbed the Gallic charge in front and struck the flanks with light infantry and horse; about twenty thousand Gauls were killed and thirty thousand taken, losses that broke the fighting power of the host, and this is the only engagement in the affair whose outcome can be settled. The Greek phase looks less like a conquest than a very successful raid. In 279 BC the Gallic host was checked at Thermopylae, pushed on into Greece, burned and plundered Delphi and other cities, and stripped the temples of their treasure; at the end it was the Locrians, paying a heavy sum, who bought the Gauls out of the Greek peninsula and sent them north. On the way back Brennus was caught in an ambush by the Locrians and the Messapians near the river Thinnius south of Thermopylae and killed, and the host broke up where it stood. The long-term result was harsh for both sides: the Gauls carried home treasure but not conquest, and the Greek league saved its homeland at the price of a ransom large enough to crush a single city-state, then went on suffering from the raids of Gallic remnants for the better part of the next two decades. The situation in the Balkans settled into its new shape through the confusion: the Illyrian alliance had broken, the Macedonian border had been shown to be exposed to a Gallic-style raid for the first time, and the Antigonid dynasty's northern policy turned from conquest to defence.
